name: Luna 20
intro: Hi! I'm Luna 20, little sibling of Luna 16.
Same job, harder place: grab soil from the bright, bumpy highlands.
My landing spot is between mountains. Steep slopes, so careful!
I only need one day. Grab and go!
briefing: We are near Mare Crisium, in the highlands just next to it.
Pick where I land for a good one-day visit.
fact: Luna 20 brought back 55 grams of highland soil, lighter in colour than the dark plains.
